jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT TAVUS

Tavus https://www.tavus.io/ is a research lab pioneering human computing. We’re building AI Humans: a new interface that closes the gap between people and machines, free from the friction of today’s systems. Our real-time human simulation models let machines see, hear, respond, and even look real—enabling meaningful, face-to-face conversations. AI Humans combine the emotional intelligence of humans with the reach and reliability of machines, making them capable, trusted agents available 24/7, in every language, on our terms.

Imagine a therapist anyone can afford. A personal trainer who adapts to your schedule. A fleet of medical assistants that can give every patient the attention they need. With Tavus, individuals, enterprises, and developers can all build AI Humans to connect, understand, and act with empathy at scale.

We’re a Series B company backed by world-class investors including Sequoia Capital, Y Combinator, and Scale Venture Partners.

Be part of shaping a future where humans and machines truly understand each other.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We're seeking a Head of Marketing to lead our go-to-market strategy during a pivotal inflection point. You'll own brand positioning, product marketing, and category creation as we introduce PALs and expand our Conversational Video Interface (CVI) API to developers and enterprises worldwide.

The unique challenge: Tavus is both a consumer and enterprise brand. You'll build marketing that resonates across prosumers discovering AI companions, developers integrating our API, and enterprise buyers deploying conversational AI at scale requiring you to craft viral cultural moments alongside rigorous B2B campaigns.

This role reports directly to the CEO and will be instrumental in defining how the world understands human computing and Tavus's leadership in this emerging category




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Category Creation & Brand Strategy

 - Define and own the "human computing" category narrative, positioning Tavus as the definitive leader in AI human interaction

 - Build a world-class brand that resonates with developers, enterprises, and prosumers

 - Drive viral awareness moments and cultural conversations. This isn't purely B2B marketing; you'll craft campaigns that capture imagination and drive organic growth

 - Develop compelling messaging and positioning across multiple audiences: technical developers (API-first), enterprise buyers, and end-users

 - Lead thought leadership initiatives, executive visibility, and other activities

Product Marketing

 - Own go-to-market strategy for PALs (consumer), CVI APIs (developers), and the Tavus Platform (enterprise)

 - Translate complex AI research (Phoenix-4, Raven-1, Sparrow-1) into compelling value propositions for technical and non-technical audiences

 - Create product narratives, sales enablement materials, case studies, and customer proof points

 - Partner closely with product and engineering to launch new features and capabilities

 - Collaborate with demand generation team to ensure messaging and positioning drive qualified pipeline

Team Building & Leadership

 - Build and scale the marketing function—recruiting, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams across product marketing, content, and brand

 - Foster a culture of experimentation, data-driven decision-making, and creative excellence

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, product, engineering, and research teams

 - Partner closely with existing demand generation leadership to align on GTM execution
   
   


WHAT YOU BRING

Required:

 - 8+ years of marketing experience, with at least 3+ years in leadership roles at consumer products industry, high-growth B2B SaaS or developer-focused companies

 - Proven track record building and scaling marketing from early stage ($5M-$50M ARR) through hypergrowth

 - Deep expertise in product marketing, brand strategy, and technical product marketing for developer-focused products

 - Experience with both product-led growth (PLG) and enterprise sales motions

 - Strong storytelling ability—you can distill complex technology into compelling narratives

 - Data-driven mindset with experience partnering with growth teams on pipeline and revenue metrics

 - Entrepreneurial builder mentality; comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving fast

Highly Valued:

 - Experience marketing cutting-edge AI/ML products or foundational models

 - Background at companies that defined new categories or emerged as category leaders

 - Technical background or deep comfort working with engineering and research teams

 - Experience marketing to multiple personas: developers, technical decision-makers, and C-suite buyers

 - Strong network in AI, developer tools, or SaaS communities
   
   


BENEFITS & CULTURE

When you join Tavus, you’re joining a diverse and supportive team. Our work is driven by our people, and our success is shared by all. This position has a flexible work schedule, unlimited PTO, competitive healthcare, and gear stipends, as well as plenty of fun. At the end of the day, we want Tavus to be a place for you to learn, directly drive impact, and work with a team you love.

To learn more about our team culture and benefits, check out our hiring page.

Tavus is growing fast, and we’d like you to grow with us. If you’re excited to get your hands dirty and help make machines more human, drop your resume and we’ll be in touch.

We are not looking for cultural fits, we are looking for culture creators. Diversity is what drives our success – it’s at the core of how we hire, communicate, and work. We are inclusive to all and combine our diverse backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives to build the best experiences for our clients.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Tavus customers are building products and experiences with conversational AI. Getting from a signed contract to a successful deployment takes more than access to the platform. Customers need clear priorities, a workable implementation plan, and a partner who understands what they are trying to accomplish.

You will report to our Customer Lead and take ownership of an existing portfolio of customers, helping them move through implementation, adoption, and renewal. You will run the day-to-day relationship, coordinate technical partners, and keep customer commitments moving.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with meaningful independence. Your portfolio will include ongoing implementations and established customers between renewal cycles. You will inherit unfinished work, build trust with customers, and establish a clear plan for what happens next.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Own your portfolio. Build relationships with the people using, implementing, and buying Tavus. Understand their business objectives, success criteria, decision process, and reasons to renew.

 - Turn customer goals into working plans. Establish milestones, owners, dependencies, and decision dates. For new customers, work with Sales and Customer Engineering to carry the buying context and agreed scope into onboarding. For existing customers, reconstruct missing context and reset the plan where needed.

 - Run dependable customer communication. Acknowledge requests, clarify their impact, secure the right internal owner, and set the next update. Keep customers informed when answers or delivery dates change, without requiring them to chase.

 - Drive adoption and customer value. Identify stalled implementations, weak engagement, and unrealized use cases. Determine whether the constraint is product quality, implementation, customer capacity, sponsorship, or fit, and coordinate a practical intervention.

 - Prioritize across accounts. Allocate attention using customer impact, revenue, growth potential, urgency, and implementation complexity. Make tradeoffs explicit when competing requests exceed available capacity.

 - Coordinate technical work. Give Customer Engineering, Support, Product, and Engineering useful context: what the customer is experiencing, what they have tried, what is blocked, and why it matters. Track the work through a verified answer or agreed next step.

 - Run renewal preparation and execution for assigned accounts. Understand renewal intent early, maintain an evidence-based forecast, develop a recommendation, and coordinate the process through a decision. Partner with the Customer Lead and Sales on negotiation and commercial approvals.

 - Identify credible expansion opportunities. Connect additional use cases to a buyer, a business outcome, and a feasible deployment path. Bring qualified opportunities to the appropriate commercial owner.

 - Maintain an actionable account record. Keep the business objective, implementation status, usage, sponsor, risks, commitments, and next decision current. Distinguish progress from completion and customer interest from an agreed commitment.

 - Improve how we operate. Turn recurring questions and successful interventions into reusable guidance, onboarding practices, and adoption and renewal playbooks. Surface product and documentation gaps with evidence of their customer impact.
   
   


HOW OWNERSHIP WORKS

You own the relationship, account plan, customer communication, and commercial readiness of your assigned portfolio. You are responsible for keeping work moving across teams and making unresolved decisions visible.

Customer Engineering owns technical implementation and troubleshooting. Product and Engineering own platform fixes and technical readiness. You work closely with those teams to establish owners, communicate confirmed capabilities and limitations, and agree on the next customer checkpoint.

When a request lacks an owner, a credible delivery plan, or an agreed scope, you escalate with the customer impact, options, and decision needed. You are comfortable setting expectations and explaining tradeoffs without promising work another team has not committed to deliver.

You will run routine account decisions independently within agreed priorities and commercial guidelines. Strategic escalations, pricing exceptions, and commitments beyond existing scope are handled with the Customer Lead and the relevant functional owner.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience independently managing a portfolio of B2B customers through implementation, adoption, and renewal.

 - Experience with APIs, AI, infrastructure, developer tools, or another technical product where customer implementation materially affects success.

 - The ability to enter an account with incomplete information, ask focused questions, and establish a coherent plan.

 - Commercial judgment: you can connect product performance, usage, customer economics, sponsorship, and business value to retention and expansion.

 - Strong follow-through across several accounts and internal teams. You keep commitments visible and recognize when a stalled next step requires a decision.

 - Clear writing and sound judgment in difficult customer conversations. You communicate uncertainty honestly, bring bad news early, and adapt the detail to your audience.

 - Enough technical fluency to understand an integration, gather useful evidence, and work credibly with engineers. Production software development is not a requirement.

 - Evidence that you can prioritize competing demands, challenge an ineffective proposed solution, and set realistic expectations while maintaining trust.

 - Comfort improving processes while using them. You can establish useful structure without waiting for a finished playbook.

We care about demonstrated ownership and judgment across these responsibilities. Relevant experience may come from Customer Success, technical account management, implementation, or another customer-facing role with substantial account responsibility.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first 30 days, you understand your initial portfolio, meet the key customer and internal stakeholders, and establish the current state of each account. You can explain what the customer wants to achieve, what is blocked, what has been promised, and what happens next. You and the Customer Lead agree on the account handoff, priorities, and escalation boundaries.

By 60 days, you independently run the customer cadence for your assigned accounts. Customers know who owns their relationship and when to expect updates. Active implementations have a shared plan, material risks are visible, and upcoming renewals have a clear recommendation and next steps.

By 90 days, the agreed portfolio has transferred to you:

 - Routine customer communication and account coordination proceed without the Customer Lead or an Account Executive directing each interaction.

 - Commitments have named owners and checkpoints; delays and decisions surface before customers need to chase.

 - Technical issues reach the right team with useful context, and customers receive accurate updates through resolution or an agreed disposition.

 - Adoption interventions and renewal plans are grounded in customer evidence, with progress and remaining constraints clearly understood.

 - Recurring problems produce improvements to guidance, handoffs, or operating practices.

 - The Customer Lead participates through scheduled portfolio reviews and defined escalations, with more capacity for strategic accounts and the broader customer organization.


WHY JOIN

You will join a Customer Success organization that is still taking shape, with real customers, meaningful commercial responsibility, and the opportunity to influence how it operates. You will work closely with Sales, Customer Engineering, Product, and Engineering to help customers turn ambitious AI use cases into products they use, value, and continue investing in.
